description:
This is a unique mix of deliciousness with the chocolate irange cinnamon buns and the vanilla cinnamon ice cream. Even if you just made the Chocolate Orange Cinnamon buns, you will not be disappointed. 

CINNAMON BUN INGREDIENTS:

For the chocolate dough:
* 60g Unsalted butter
* 220g Whole milk
* 1 packet (11g) Fast-action dried yeast
* 50g Caster sugar
* 1 medium Egg room temperature
* 1 medium Egg yolk room temperature
* 460g Strong white bread flour plus more for dusting
* 50g Cocoa powder I used Menier 100% Cocoa Powder
* 5g Salt

For the orange cinnamon sugar filling:
* 60g unsalted butter room temperature
* 120g light brown sugar/muscovado sugar
* 20g ground cinnamon
* 1 large Orange zest only

For the chocolate orange cream cheese frosting:
* 50 grams Milk chocolate I use Menier Swiss Milk Chocolate
* 75 grams Full-fat cream cheese room temperature
* 50 grams Icing sugar
* 1 large Orange juice only (you can use up the orange that was zested for the filling)

The vanilla cinnamon ice cream is super simple as you can see.
